last_decision.monologue: Ten hours in and the fog's not helping. I thought that ridge looked familiar but nothing out here looks familiar twice. Compass says I'm holding bearing, gut says I drifted west of the trail somewhere past the last book. Legs are heavy, not done-heavy, just tired-heavy. Ate, drank, kept moving. If the ground starts climbing again I'll know I'm back on line. If it doesn't, I'm trusting the compass over the gut. The gut's been wrong all night.
